kinds.d: Mower whose rotating discs or drums cut grass for hay or silage.
Implement whose blades on a vertical shaft cut grass, weeds and brush under a deck.
Implement that cuts and shreds standing vegetation on grassland, verges, vineyards and scrub.

notes: Restraint only. The 23 Kuhn/Krone disc-mower models cut to three ranges; the nine Bush Hog rotary-cutter models cut to one example plus the flex-wing range (moved here from Flail mower, where it was misfiled). Dropped the "rotary cutter" alias from Flail mower; FW2110/FW4120 flex-wing models dropped with it.
